age_seconds.description: Age of the data at response time

as_of.description: When the data was read from the ledger

ledger_index.description: Validated ledger the data comes from

stale.description: True when served past its fresh TTL (stale-on-error)

auction_slot.description: Auction slot: active while unexpired at the read ledger, discounted fee as a fraction, expiry time; null when no account holds the slot

frozen.description: Per asset: true when the asset is frozen, so the pool cannot be traded

lp_token.description: LP token of the pool: currency code, issuer (the AMM account) and outstanding supply

spot_a_per_b.description: Fee-free pool price of one b in a: reserve_a / reserve_b; null for an empty pool

spot_a_per_b_with_fee.description: Marginal price of one b in a including the trading fee: spot_a_per_b / (1 - trading_fee); null for an empty pool

spot_b_per_a.description: Fee-free pool price of one a in b: reserve_b / reserve_a; null for an empty pool

spot_b_per_a_with_fee.description: Marginal price of one a in b including the trading fee: spot_b_per_a / (1 - trading_fee); null for an empty pool

value_per_lp_token.description: Reserves per LP token: reserve_a / supply and reserve_b / supply; null for an empty pool

vote_dispersion.description: Trading-fee votes: count, lowest and highest voted fee as fractions, and the vote-weighted standard deviation (null when the weights sum to zero); null without votes

description: AMM pool reserves and trading fee for an asset pair. When to use: To read AMM pool depth and fee for a pair. Prefer another tool: It does not estimate slippage or compare venues (use the slippage page for the CLOB vs AMM comparison); a pair without a pool returns 404. Example: xrpl_amm {"a":"XRP","b":"5553444300000000000000000000000000000000.rGm7WCVp9gb4jZHWTEtGUr4dd74z2XuWhE"} Credits only: paid by prepaid credit, 0.0025 EUR or 0.003 USD units per call; buy a bundle first at https://api.criptonlabs.com/v1/pro/credits/{bundle} or with `credits_topup`, then call with the `clc_` token or Sign-In-With-X.

a.description: First asset: `XRP`, or `CODE.issuer`: `CODE` is a 3-character standard code or 40 hexadecimal digits, and `issuer` is a classic XRPL address. Standard codes are case-sensitive: `usd` and `USD` are different tokens, so send the exact code. A standard code uses letters, digits or `?!@#$%^&*<>(){}[]|` and is never `XRP`; percent-encode the symbols in a URL (for example `%3F` for `?`). A 40-hex code is read in any case, and the 40-hex form of a standard code means that code.
